pages.text: Using various scraps from the Toxic Caves, you have created a radioactive nest. Right-clicking it with Sulfur Dust produces loyal Gammaroach Servants.

Right-clicking the nest with a Wand or Staff will make it so that it will only spawn a servant if a valid target is near it. While crouching, however, it will change whether the servant will spawn guarding the block or following the owner.
